findings.reason: §3 stands on unlanded imas-ink machinery exactly as §4 does, so §3 should either be marked `deferred` behind that plan (the disposition §4 already took for its unlanded `geometry-figure-vessel-units` dependency) or its text should stop asserting the behaviour already exists.
findings.text: §3 (status `implementable`) asserts in the present tense that "long traces are drawn at display resolution and the shared time axis is labelled once, by imas-ink's `trace-figure-display-resolution` plan", but that plan (imas-ink `docs/plans/trace-figure-display-resolution.html`) is `draft` with §1 (min/max envelope) and §2 (single time-axis label) both `implementable`, and imas-ink has no such code: a recursive search of `imas_ink/` for envelope|simplif|decimat|downsample|max_points|min_max returns only two comment hits in `three_d/coilset.py` about a geometric TF case envelope, unrelated to trace drawing, while the same search over known-present strings (linestyle, `def time_trace_figure_mpl`) returns matches and so is shown to see what is there — a worker implementing §3 as written would expect the envelope and single label to be provided and they are not

reuse_search-1.reason: §3 is held on imas-ink:trace-figure-display-resolution through plan-section-depends-on and does not dispatch until that plan lands; the sentence states what §3 relies on when it runs

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §3 adds one function (`read_channel`) plus one caller script whose drawing is delegated to imas-ink's `time_trace_figure_mpl`; no sprawl of shallow wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the cache's raw read has no existing owner (`VirtualZarrView`/`ZarrTransformEngine` read transformed values with no time base, and `tests/data/test_eddb_cache.py` only inlines the zarr read), so `read_channel` belongs beside `write_channel` in the layout owner `imas_ambix/data/eddb.py` rather than forking a new one; the only shared machinery the two figure scripts both reach is `imas_ink/io.py`'s `render_to_bytes`, which §2 already uses and §3 can reuse.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §3 names `read_channel` and its script as additions and states it retires nothing because they are the read counterpart nothing provides, §2b adds no public name, §4 names its single public addition.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §3 cites imas-ink's `trace-figure-display-resolution` machinery (min/max-envelope drawing, single time-axis label) as already doing that work, but that plan is still draft with both sections implementable and `imas_ink/` carries no such code.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — `read_channel` is justified as the raw read beside the engine path that supplies the time base `VirtualZarrView` cannot, and the signals script is justified as a second caller reading the EDDB cache rather than the description store.
